text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Brian-chan. It's your 
special day♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Brian-chan is going to get so 
much stronger this year compared to last 
year!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The day one was born matters not. For my 
stride shall never cease.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I am different today than I was 
yesterday. However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow, I'll be someone even better.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, you keep pulling further 
and further ahead. But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I was just thinking that 
Brian-chan is as amazing as everâª

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even so, today is still a day for 
celebration. So let me say it once again—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday! I won't let my progress 
halt for even a single day, either.
